findings.issue: Common noun צָרַעַת (H6883) is left as the transliteration tsaráat; a non-name lemma stays in Spanish.
Masculine tokens יְרַקְרַק, אֲדַמְדָּם, הוּא (3ms), and the hophal 3ms verb are smoothed to feminine Spanish agreement with plaga.

notes: Other tokens match in order, number, person, and hophal passive; the verbless clause adds no unmarked copula.
